description:
**Phase E — Compaction orchestration. Deps: E5a-pre (opi-ixp.47), E5a-pre² (opi-ixp.48), E3 (opi-ixp.22).**

Per upstream pattern: compaction NEVER mutates the message log; the kept window is computed at prompt-assembly time via `build_session_context`.

Today, the run-process (post-opi-ixp.47) sends `MessageLog.to_list/1` to the LLM. After this ticket, when a `coder_session` ref is set on the run-process, it instead calls `Coder.Session.build_session_context/1` (opi-ixp.48) and pipes the result through `Coder.Session.Messages.to_llm/1` (E3) before handing it to the transport. When no `coder_session` is attached, the run-process falls back to `MessageLog.to_list/1` so the Agent app stays runnable standalone.

`MessageLog` remains append-only (current API: push/append_many/to_list/count) — no new mutation methods needed.

Tests: integration test confirming the run-process receives the rebuilt list (kept window + synthetic summary) after a CompactionEntry is appended to the SessionManager.
title: E5a. Run-process reads from Coder.Session.build_session_context/1
